title: Density-aware contrast, proportional radius, and shadow regimen
creator: Maya Chen
description: Short summary: Introduce density-aware color contrast math, a proportional radius scale that adapts to compact/comfortable modes, and a two-channel shadow regimen (ambient + interaction key) to improve legibility and tactile affordance in high-density tables and compact controls. This ticket scopes token definitions, Figma assets, migration guidelines, and a small implementation checklist for component engineers.
acceptance_criteria: New semantic color tokens defined with delta values for high/low density and validated against WCAG 2.1 AA for body and UI states
Proportional radius scale (px and unitless) published and integrated into button, input, chip, and table tokens with examples for compact/comfortable breakpoints
Shadow/elevation tokens split into ambient and key interaction layers with runtime-friendly variables and examples for hover, focus, pressed
Figma library updated with component variants and a migration doc for engineers with PR checklist
Automated visual regression tests added for primary components (button, table, card) showing compact vs comfortable snapshots
tasks: Define algorithm for density-adjusted contrast (design + accessibility) and publish test cases
Prototype proportional radius scale and get sign-off from product/engineering
Draft shadow layering system and produce light/dark previews for key components
Update Figma tokens and component instances; export token JSON for engineers
Create migration guide and example PR template for component owners
Coordinate with ENG to add new CSS variables and feature flag for rollout
comments: 2025-11-12 | Maya Chen: Initial draft — proposed proportional radius values (4,8,12) mapped to density scale; proposed contrast deltas +6% for dense mode.
2025-11-15 | Rafael Ortega: Reviewed prototypes. Request to soften hover key shadows on dark theme; flagged potential perf issues with multi-layer shadows.

2025-11-18 | Aisha Park (Accessibility): Ran contrast checks — semantic token pairs pass AA at 14px body but need tweaks for small captions in dense tables. Recommend slight hue shift instead of pure darkening.

2025-11-20 | Luca Moreno (Engineering): Proposed implementation: expose --rdw-radius-scale and --rdw-elevation-ambient / --rdw-elevation-key CSS vars, and a density flag on body to switch token deltas.
2025-11-24 | PM Review (Sophie Dubois): Aligns with roadmap, suggests delaying rollout until minimal API for runtime token selection exists (ENG-2042 dependency).
2025-11-27 | Rafael Ortega: Updated Figma components and added compact variants; opened PR for tokens JSON (see attachment). Requesting design review for dark theme adjustments.
